summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the final analytic voting map for items 2 and 3 of an extraordinary general meeting held on July 22, 2026, with 3,508,495,389 common shares voted (82.4% of voting capital). This is a routine post-meeting report on shareholder votes; no special situation event is described. No deal terms, strategic action, or corporate change is mentioned. The filing is an ordinary regulatory update for a Brazilian issuer under Rule 13a-16. No further analysis applies.
